proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The report had 14 numbered findings with photos. Numbers 3 and 9 were hail, the rest was just age. The adjuster used their roof diagram and approved two slopes I expected him to skip.
reviews.name: Danielle R.

reviews.text: Asked three companies how big my roof was. Got 28, 34 and 31 squares. These folks showed me the math on paper: 29.4 plus waste. That's who got the job.
reviews.name: Owen F.

reviews.text: They would not touch my deductible, said Texas law doesn't allow it, then walked me through the whole claim on one page. Felt like the only straight conversation I had all spring.
reviews.name: Carla N.

reviews.text: Leak over the garage turned out to be a split pipe boot. Photo of the split, photo of the new boot, out of my driveway in under an hour.
reviews.name: Hector V.

reviews.text: We compared Class 3 and Class 4 on their sheet with the extra cost written next to each. Went with Class 4. Two storms since and no claim on our end, while half the street got new roofs again.
reviews.name: Meredith L.

reviews.text: Back porch roof kept holding water. Before quoting, he laid a 4-foot level across it and showed me the dip. After the coating, rain runs straight to the gutter.
reviews.name: Gary P.

reviews.text: Did not love that they were booked out nine days after the May storm. Did love that the price on the report was the price on the invoice, to the dollar.
reviews.name: Ashley K.

proof.guarantee: Any leak in our replacement work during the first 10 years, we come back and repair it.
